senses.gloss: f. (רבק, Arab. rabaḳ to join, tie; cmp. רבג, רבך) team.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Parah 2:3">Tosef. Par. II</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 1:3">I</cite>), 3 <he>הכניסה לר׳ ודשה עם אמה</he> if he took the young red cow into the team (that she may suck), and she did (accidentally) some threshing with her mother; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 30a">B. Mets. 30ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Gittin 53a">Gitt. 53ᵃ</cite>.—Pl. <he>רִבְקוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Eiruvin 2:4">Tosef. Erub. II (I), 2</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 2:1">Erub. II, 1</cite> <he>כמלוא שתי ר׳ וכ׳</he> the space required by two teams of three animals each.
